findings.description: The 'data' bucket sets no ACL and no aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block, and the in-file comment states the bucket is public; it stores a customer master spreadsheet, so anonymous read/enumeration of sensitive customer records is possible if any public ACL or policy is applied.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so the customer master data object is stored without enforced SSE-KMS encryption.
The bucket has no logging block, so access to this publicly exposed bucket holding customer data leaves no S3 access trail for detection or forensics.
No bucket policy denying requests with aws:SecureTransport = false is attached, so objects in this public bucket may be retrieved over plaintext HTTP.

'customer-master.xlsx' is uploaded into the public, unencrypted aws_s3_bucket.data with no per-object kms_key_id, and the file is committed to the repository source tree, exposing sensitive customer records.
The financials bucket defines no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving financial records stored without enforced encryption at rest.
No logging block is configured for a bucket holding financial data, removing the audit trail needed to detect unauthorised access.
No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block is attached, so a later ACL or bucket policy change could expose financial data publicly without an account-level guardrail.
No server-side encryption configuration is defined for the operations bucket, so its contents are stored without enforced encryption at rest.
The operations bucket has no logging block configured, leaving no record of object access for incident investigation.
No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block is attached to this bucket, leaving no defence-in-depth guardrail against a subsequent public ACL or policy grant.
The data_science bucket lacks a server_side_encryption_configuration block, so datasets are persisted without enforced encryption at rest.
No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block is attached, so a later ACL or bucket policy change could expose data science datasets publicly.
The log bucket has no aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block attached, so a later ACL or bucket policy change could silently expose collected access logs.
